## Holocene CCM {#fig-holocene-ccm}

::: {.row .favorite-figures-banner}

::: {.col-lg-3 .col-md-6 .favorite-figure}
[![](/favorite_figures/holocene_ccm/img/thumbs/Fig1_raw_ts_psd.jpg){.img-fluid}](/favorite_figures/holocene_ccm/img/display/Fig1_raw_ts_psd.jpg){.portfolio-lightbox data-gallery="favoriteFiguresGallery" title="Raw time series & spectral significance"}

Reconstructed GMST and TSI records (8000 BP–present), with spectral significance testing against AR(1) surrogates highlighting the Hallstatt, de Vries, and Gleissberg solar cycles.

CCM skill (Δρ) across embedding-dimension and time-delay choices, for each temperature/TSI reconstruction pairing, with surrogate-exceedance markers overlaid.

[PDF](/favorite_figures/holocene_ccm/pdf/Fig3_untreated_results_Grid_2x2.pdf){.figure-pdf-link}
:::
